name: Upgrade options
description: Which image to install, and how far the job is allowed to go.

spec.question_description: File name of the Junos image in /var/tmp on the switch, for example junos-arm-32-25.2R2-S2.2.tgz
The 32-character MD5 checksum the image should have.
Optional. Leave blank to take it from the file name. Example: 25.2R2-S2.2
Yes: the switch checks the image against its configuration before installing (about 10 minutes on an EX2300). No: skip that check.
check_only: run the checks and stop, nothing is installed. install_only: install, no reboot. install_and_reboot: install, reboot, wait and verify.

spec.question_name: Save the rescue config if none is set?
spec.question_description: Recommended. Only applies when something gets installed.
